name: claude-code-glow
description: Color themes for the whole Claude Code interface, a themed status line, and a live HUD with zero-token tips that help you spend fewer tokens.

plugins.name: glowline
plugins.description: A status line with a live context meter, plan limits and zero-token tips in 15 themes, 14 of which also recolor the whole Claude Code interface (pick them in /theme), plus /glowline:setup, /glowline:theme and /glowline:doctor.

plugins.name: glowbar
plugins.description: Early access: a themed bar above the prompt with a live context meter, plan limits, session cost, a token-saving tip and one-key Compact and Theme buttons, plus a /glow theme picker. Terminal and desktop app. Needs Claude Code 2.1.286 or newer.
